candidates.description: This feature vector activates on Arabic and Hindi script fragments, representing multilingual character sub-tokens.
These tokens represent various Hindi vowel sign and consonant-vowel combinations used in Devanagari script.
This vector is related to common Hindi suffixes and grammatical endings used in word formation.
This vector represents the Devanagari letter 'भ' (bha) and its common variations with vowel signs and conjuncts.
This vector represents common character fragments and subword units from the Devanagari script and Arabic text.
This vector activates for various Hindi vowel sign characters attached to commas and punctuation marks.
This vector represents Hindi vowel signs, matras, and character fragments associated with Devanagari script typography.
This feature vector represents character combinations and subword components specific to the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and fragments specific to Hindi script and Devanagari character combinations.
This vector activates for specific Devanagari script characters, particularly retroflex consonants and vowel signs.
